items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I was good friends. He used to tell me, said, you were on alto, said, why did you go back to tenor?

ctx.x: I was good friends. He used to tell me, said, you were on alto, said, why did you go back to tenor? I said, I like the tenor better. He said, stay on it. And Hawk always told me, he says, look, says, you got -- one thing about it I like about you. You don't let nobody influence you. He said, you got your own way of doing things. I said, well, Hawk, I learned that. Just part of me, I said, I love everybody's playing, but I won't let their influence just -- like in later years in New York when bebop came in, once…
